title: Ebale Oyo Emonisaki Mitema
intro: Kanisá limpinga moko oyo ezali kotambola, oyo ezali na mposa ya mai mpe emekami, epai wapi komande moko na libongo ya ebale ekokabola ekateli na mposa. Mokambi oyo aponami akambaka milɔngɔ epai ya monguna moko ya nguya, amemaka elikya kaka na Allah.
clues: Naponamaki na Allah lokola mokambi likolo ya Bana ya Israel sima ya kosenga moko mpo na kobunda na nzela na Ye.
Bapesaki ngai boyebi mingi mpe molai lokola elembo ya koponama na ngai, atako bato na ngai batyaki ntembe na bokonzi na ngai.
Nakendeki elongo na mampinga mpe nayebisaki bango ete Allah akomeka bango na ebale.
Nakebisaki ete moto nyonso oyo akomɛla yango na bonsomi akozala ya ngai te, longola kaka moto oyo azwaki mwa ndambo.
Nakatisaki elongo na mwa bato moke oyo batikalaki ngwi, kokutana na limpinga oyo eleki mingi na motángo.
Nakambaki baye balobaki mbala boni compagnie ya moke elongaka ya monene na ndingisa ya Allah, yambo Jalut alonga.

identity.label: Nazali Nani?
options: Abu Lahab azali moto ya mayele

trial.label: Momekano/Evenement
options: Kolala na kati ya libulu na boumeli ya bambula mingi
Komeka basoda na ebale liboso ya etumba
trial.answer: Komeka basoda na ebale liboso ya etumba

outcome.label: Resultat
options: Komela na mabele na biloko ya motuya
Bobongwani na ba singes mpo na kobuka mobeko
Kobebisama na nzela ya mopɛpɛ makasi
Elonga na ndingisa ya Allah mpe Jalut abomamaki na Dawud
Kozinda na mbu elongo na bayambi
outcome.answer: Elonga na ndingisa ya Allah mpe Jalut abomamaki na Dawud

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
